dialogs.text: Tell of how you dispelled the Seven-Star Array...
You tell Taliesin of the things that happened...
Huh... "And so, with the aid of a faithful servant"... Wait. No, that won't do.
#"With the aid of a faithful friend, {NICKNAME} breached the path leading to the mines!"
Uh... Is this really okay? We didn't ask her permission to use her in the story...
Ah, fret not, fret not! Heroes do not act as ordinary people might, and are not bound by such banal rules! Nobody will mind!
Tell of the darkness and the creatures from the Abyss...
You tell Taliesin of the things that happened...
My, oh my. This is great. This is perfect! Give me a moment, let me write it all down.
"The dark fog pressed in like an avalanche, and the two apostles of the Abyss, now separated, disappeared without a trace, just as they had appeared..."
Tell of the azure crystal you found in the depths of the Chasm.
You tell Taliesin of the things that happened...
"The skies and the waters alike flowed across the crystal's surface, and the purple and red splotches faded..."
#"The ancient creature of the ruins reeled, having taken a blow from {NICKNAME}'s iron fist, and it was at this moment that the star of the show arrived!"
"...The mysterious ally that came to the Traveler's aid had vanished without a trace, but the giant construct serpent had already been shattered to pieces by the crystal..."
Tell of the fluorescent fungi in the caves...
You tell Taliesin of the things that happened...
Fascinating... Almost unthinkable, really... Let me think for a moment before I say anything.
"And though it be a giant mushroom towering unto the sky, it was helpless before the encroaching dark..."
#"Answering the call, {NICKNAME} came forth, purifying the land and staving the crisis off..."
Tell of the nine Black Serpent Knights...
You tell Taliesin of the things that happened...
This... This is wonderful! "And so, the fated Traveler said: 'Forget coming at me one by one. I could take all nine of you on at once!'"
Uh, that's a bit of an exaggeration...
It's alright... Now, if you'll allow me, I might exercise some creative license with the former lives of those nine swordsmen...
Tell of your search for your kin...
You tell Taliesin of the things that happened...
That is... fascinating indeed. An ancient, forgotten land, sacrifices that went unacknowledged, and an unjust punishment to fall into folly... What huge themes! What an expansive tale!
And to think that such stories are things that you've encountered in your travels, and that are so very close to your own aims...

Thank you for sharing all these with me. I will record them down. That said, I don't believe that I shall compose a poem from them yet... I believe that these will only be small fragments of your saga.
I will not tell your tale with the limited skill that I have... I ask only that you tell me of your journey once it is complete.
My intuition tells me that when that day comes, my ears shall be blessed with the most heroic tale known to this world.
Tell of the Fatui who met with a crisis...
You tell Taliesin of the things that happened...
Haha! That's such an interesting story! "'A bitter day this is, that we should be saved by our great foe!' Serzhant Anton exclaimed with a sigh..."
"Yet those who meet as friends today, tomorrow may meet as foes."
Tell of the people you've met and the things you've seen.
Yes, please do tell me everything. I am all ears.
Tell of your adventures in The Chasm.
Alright then. Please, do go on.
#Ho there, if it isn't {NICKNAME}, the great hero who subdued the Dragon of the East and saved my homeland! Well met, well met!
#You've come, {NICKNAME}, challenger of the Fatui Harbinger, and deliverer of Liyue from its monstrous sea-foes!
#Ah, if it isn't the one who dispersed the great storm that lay over the land of thunder, {NICKNAME}! Come, come!
#Hail to you, {NICKNAME}, great adventurer who once strode up to Dragonspine's very summit!
Well met, Traveler, before whom even Fatui Harbingers had to admit defeat in distant lands!
This might seem a little sudden, good hero, but could you spare a moment to tell me a story or two of yours for me to turn into songs for those who come after?
Well, if you just need me to tell you stories...
I would be most grateful if you were to agree! Well then, fire away! I'm listening.
I've got a ton of stories to tell.
Thank you for helping me finish this epic poem... Ah, yes. Please, take this copy of my manuscript as thanks!
Phew... This epic manuscript carries both my emotions and ambitions. Please, take it. It is what little I can do to repay you.
See you.
#May all go well with you. Thank you for your time, {NICKNAME} — and may your valor be known throughout the world!
